The '''Virujansi Rarefied Air Cavalry''' was [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi's]] most elite [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]. When [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces [[Battle of Virujansi|attempted to capture]] [[Unparala]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Rarefied Air Cavalry assisted [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Among their number was future [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]], who served as [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
